text: Yes, the property lost tree cover in 2024. Earth-observation data detected 0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss that year, though this was not classified as an event due to being below the 0.5-hectare threshold. The loss follows a 0.7-hectare event confirmed in 2023. The total tree cover in 2020 was 34.8 hectares (59.9% of the property). The changes reflect stand-replacing events (e.g., cutting or clearing), but the cause or legality of the loss is not specified.
